payload.summary: Found by the Phase 2 exit test on speed-count-game: afk-run's gate 1a reads inception.constitution_signed_by, which every pre-Phase-2 founding lacks — even when the journal carries a genuinely human-attributed sign-off act (speed-count-game event q0wnarsr). A legacy repo can't pass the gate without a human present. Design options for the fix: gate falls back to scanning for a human-attributed constitution sign-off note; or nahel migrate-founding command a human runs once; or inception re-run guidance. Orchestrator transcribed the field as scribe citing the human act for the exit test, deviation surfaced.
